stories.title: The Devourer of Worlds
stories.description: A cinematic fantasy space war explaining how a conflict began, why a living planet was targeted, and how a forbidden black hole weapon changed the galaxy forever.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic view of deep space filled with glowing nebula clouds and distant stars. An abrupt, aggressive camera push-in toward two opposing fantasy star fleets facing each other across space creates immediate tension. The motion rapidly eases and settles into slow cinematic forward drift. Massive warships hold position, weapons glowing but unfired. Epic lighting, high contrast, grand scale, fantasy sci-fi style, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: HOOK + SETUP: Two fleets face each other, signaling a long-standing conflict about to erupt.

scenes.narration: The war began long before the first shot.

Multiple elements: vast blue oceans, lush green continents, glowing advanced cities, radiant energy veins visible beneath the planet’s surface, soft clouds wrapping the atmosphere, a warm sun illuminating the world. Camera: slow majestic orbital drift around the planet, calm and beautiful motion, vibrant yet natural colors, cinematic lighting, epic scale, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: WHAT WAS AT STAKE: A living planet that holds immense power capable of ending—or winning—the war.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide cinematic shot of a colossal command ship revealing a forbidden weapon known as the Devourer of Worlds. Multiple elements: a swirling sphere of absolute darkness forming in space, violent gravitational distortion bending nearby stars and light, surrounding allied ships slowly retreating. Camera: slow controlled push-in toward the forming black hole weapon, ominous lighting, epic fantasy scale, 720p.
scenes.visual_reference: THE DECISION: Leaders choose destruction over letting the enemy claim the planet’s power.

Camera: slow dramatic pull-back revealing the planet’s destruction at massive scale, tragic lighting, epic fantasy sci-fi mood, 720p.
